ayahOccurrences.text: وَإِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ سَرِّحُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ ۚ وَلَا تُمْسِكُوهُنَّ ضِرَارًا لِّتَعْتَدُوا۟ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُۥ ۚ وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ آيَاتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوًا ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْحِكْمَةِ يَعِظُكُم بِهِۦ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ رَبِّ أَرِنِى كَيْفَ تُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۖ قَالَ أَوَلَمْ تُؤْمِن ۖ قَالَ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِى ۖ قَالَ فَخُذْ أَرْبَعَةً مِّنَ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَصُرْهُنَّ إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ جَبَلٍ مِّنْهُنَّ جُزْءًا ثُمَّ ٱدْعُهُنَّ يَأْتِينَكَ سَعْيًا ۚ وَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنفِقُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا كَسَبْتُمْ وَمِمَّآ أَخْرَجْنَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَلَا تَيَمَّمُوا۟ ٱلْخَبِيثَ مِنْهُ تُنفِقُونَ وَلَسْتُم بِـَٔاخِذِيهِ إِلَّآ أَن تُغْمِضُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَا يَأْمُرَكُمْ أَن تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ وَٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ أَرْبَابًا ۗ أَيَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرَّسُولُ لَا يَحْزُنكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْكُفْرِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ آمَنَّا بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَلَمْ تُؤْمِن قُلُوبُهُمْ ۛ وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ ۛ سَمَّٰعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ سَمَّٰعُونَ لِقَوْمٍ آخَرِينَ لَمْ يَأْتُوكَ ۖ يُحَرِّفُونَ ٱلْكَلِمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَوَاضِعِهِۦ ۖ يَقُولُونَ إِنْ أُوتِيتُمْ هَٰذَا فَخُذُوهُ وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْتَوْهُ فَٱحْذَرُوا۟ ۚ وَمَن يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ فِتْنَتَهُۥ فَلَن تَمْلِكَ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُطَهِّرَ قُلُوبَهُمْ ۚ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌ ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِى الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
أَخَذَ ʾakhadha u [v. trans., pass. v. أُخِذَ ʾukhidha]

1 to take

(4:20) وَءَاتَيْتُمْ إِحْدَاهُنَّ قِنْطَارًا فَلاَ تَأْخُذُوا مِنْهُ شَيْئًا and [even if] you have given any one of them [as a dower] a ton [of gold], do not take any of it [back]

2 to take away, remove

(6:46) إِنْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَأَبْصَارَكُمْ if God were to take away your hearing and your sight

3 [with prep. ﺒ] to grab, to take hold of

(7:150) وَأَخَذَ بِرَأْسِ أَخِيهِ يَجُرُّهُ إِلَيْهِ and he took hold of the head of his brother, dragging him to him; *

(2:206) أَخَذَتْهُ الْعِزَّةُ بِالإِثْمِ his arrogance drives him to stick to his sins [lit. the pride in sinning overtook him]; *

(9:50) قَدْ أَخَذْنَا أَمْرَنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ we have taken our precautions beforehand; *

(10:24) أَخَذَتِ الأَرْضُ زُخْرُفَهَا the earth has taken on its ornaments

4 to accept, to take on board, to follow

(5:41) يَقُولُونَ إِنْ أُوتِيتُمْ هَذَا فَخُذُوهُ they say [to each other], ‘If you are given this [ruling], accept it!’

5 to punish, to take to task

(29:40) فَكُلاًّ أَخَذْنَا بِذَنْبِهِ so We punished each one of them for their sins

6 to afflict, to overtake, to seize

(7:78) فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِى دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ an earthquake seized them: by the next morning they were lying dead in their homes

7 to overpower, to overwhelm, to overtake

(2:255) لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him

8 [with prep. ﺒ] to try, to test, to afflict

(7:130) وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِينَ We tried Pharaoh’s people with the passage of time [lit. the years].

أَخَذَ ʾakhadha u [v. trans., pass. v. أُخِذَ ʾukhidha]

1 to take

(4:20) وَءَاتَيْتُمْ إِحْدَاهُنَّ قِنْطَارًا فَلاَ تَأْخُذُوا مِنْهُ شَيْئًا and [even if] you have given any one of them [as a dower] a ton [of gold], do not take any of it [back]

2 to take away, remove

(6:46) إِنْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَأَبْصَارَكُمْ if God were to take away your hearing and your sight

3 [with prep. ﺒ] to grab, to take hold of

(7:150) وَأَخَذَ بِرَأْسِ أَخِيهِ يَجُرُّهُ إِلَيْهِ and he took hold of the head of his brother, dragging him to him; *

(2:206) أَخَذَتْهُ الْعِزَّةُ بِالإِثْمِ his arrogance drives him to stick to his sins [lit. the pride in sinning overtook him]; *

(9:50) قَدْ أَخَذْنَا أَمْرَنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ we have taken our precautions beforehand; *

(10:24) أَخَذَتِ الأَرْضُ زُخْرُفَهَا the earth has taken on its ornaments

4 to accept, to take on board, to follow

(5:41) يَقُولُونَ إِنْ أُوتِيتُمْ هَذَا فَخُذُوهُ they say [to each other], ‘If you are given this [ruling], accept it!’

5 to punish, to take to task

(29:40) فَكُلاًّ أَخَذْنَا بِذَنْبِهِ so We punished each one of them for their sins

6 to afflict, to overtake, to seize

(7:78) فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِى دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ an earthquake seized them: by the next morning they were lying dead in their homes

7 to overpower, to overwhelm, to overtake

(2:255) لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him

8 [with prep. ﺒ] to try, to test, to afflict

(7:130) وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِينَ We tried Pharaoh’s people with the passage of time [lit. the years].

entries.label: آخِذٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
آخِذٌ ʾākhidh [act. part.; pl. آخِذِين ʾākhidhīn]

1 one who takes or accepts something

(51:16) ءَاخِذِينَ مَا ءَاتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ they will be taking what their Lord gives them

2 one who takes hold of, one who controls

(11:56) مَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ إِلاَّ هُوَ ءَاخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا there is no animal but He is in complete control of it [lit. taking hold of its forelock].

entries.label: أَخْذٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَخْذٌ ʾakhdh [v. n.] taking, taking to task, punishment

(11:102) وَكَذَلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَا أَخَذَ الْقُرَى وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُ أَلِيمٌ شَدِيدٌ such is the punishment of your Lord for towns in the midst of their sins: His punishment is terrible and severe.

entries.label: أَخْذَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَخْذَةٌ ʾakhdhatun [n. of unit] a taking, a gripping; an instance of taking to task; to seize; to take to task

(69:10) فَعَصَوْا رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَابِيَةً but they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an immense gripping.

entries.label: اِتِّخَاذٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
اِتِّخَاذٌ ʾittikhādh [v. n.] (act of) adopting or taking something to be something else

(2:54) إِنَّكُمْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ بِاتِّخَاذِكُمُ الْعِجْلَ [indeed] you have wronged yourselves by taking the calf [for a deity].

entries.label: مُتَّخِذٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُتَّخِذٌ muttakhidh [act. part.; pl. مُتَّخِذِين muttakhidhīn; pl. fem. مُتَّخِذَاتٌ muttakhidhāt]

1 one who takes for him/herself something or someone

(4:25) غَيْرَ مُسَافِحَاتٍ وَلاَ مُتَّخِذَاتِ أَخْدَانٍ not committing adultery or taking lovers

2 one who takes someone for

(18:51) وَمَا كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذَ الْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًا and I would not take those who lead others astray for supporters.

entries.label: يُؤَاخِذُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يُؤَاخِذُ yuʾākhidh [imperf. of v. III, trans.] to take to task, to hold to account, to punish

(2:286) رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make mistakes.

entries.label: ِإِتَّخَذَ
entries.definitionHtml:
ِإِتَّخَذَ ʾittakhadha [v. VIII] I [trans.]

1 to take for oneself, to adopt

(16:51) وَقَالَ اللَّهُ لاَ تَتَّخِذُوا إِلَهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ God said, ‘Do not take two gods’–for He is the one God

2 to fashion for oneself, to create for one’s use

(29:41) مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ كَمَثَلِ الْعَنْكَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا those who take protectors besides God are like a spider taking for itself a house

3 to select, to follow, to take

(18:63) وَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِى الْبَحْرِ عَجَبًا and it took its way into the sea in a wondrous manner

4 to exact, to acquire, to require, to obtain

(18:77) لَوْ شِئْتَ لاَتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا but if you had wished you could have exacted payment for [doing] it

5 to take something as

(23:110) فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا but you made them [lit. took them as] a laughing stock; *

(11:92) وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَاءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا you have turned your backs on Him, you have put Him out of your minds [lit. you put Him behind you]; *

(19:88) وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَلَدًا they say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has begotten offspring’ [lit. taken an offspring]

6 [with prep. مِن] to derive something out of

(16:67) وَمِنْ ثَمَرَاتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالأَعْنَابِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا from the fruits of date palms and grapes you derive intoxicants and wholesome provisions II [doubly trans.]

1 to use something for the purpose of

(58:16) اتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً they have used their oaths to cover up [their false deeds]

2 to take, adopt someone as

(4:125) وَاتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلا God took Abraham as a friend.
